assessment: This article provides insight into the importance of a voltage-gated sodium channel in proprioceptors, a group of mechanosensory neurons that target muscle. Using pharmacology, gene knockout, behavior, and histology in mice, the authors show quite convincingly that NaV1.1 in sensory neurons is essential for normal motor behavior and contributes to proprioceptor excitability. The work has interesting implications for human subjects with inherited variants of Nav1.1.
